_doc: Cross-system seam SSOT for immune_hematologic_vp_site (v0.20.0, sections 16+18+19+20+21). The immune volume is the IMMUNOSURVEILLANCE / TOLERANCE / INFLAMMATION HUB of the VP program: its discriminative primitives -- the tolerance saddle-node (T21 deletion / T23 break / T24 suppressor complement), the systemic cytokine latch (T31), the immunosurveillance escape multiplier (T5/T10), and the hematopoietic root (bone_marrow_hematopoiesis, RUNX1) -- are READ by sibling volumes that instantiate them in a specific tissue or felt register. FIVE declared seams: section 16 wired the original three (gut-immune shared-substrate identity, neuro-immune sign-IN/pointer-OUT, oncology hub); section 18 (v0.17.0) promotes two inherited adjacencies to declared one-way pointers (circulatory leukocyte trafficking; musculoskeletal marrow niche, with a NAMED shared-substrate-identity upgrade candidate). Section 19 (v0.18.0) shows the gut-immune identity is BARRIER-SURFACE-AGNOSTIC -- the tolerance switch's induction = antigen + spinodal and maintenance = antigen - spinodal hold for ANY barrier antigen, so the surface-independent OFFSET is always +/- the spinodal -- and on that footing declares respiratory mucosal immunity and skin barrier immunity as NAMED shared-substrate-identity CANDIDATES (NOT declared seams: each needs its live barrier volume + that volume's owned absolute antigen scale, neither on disk). The two named candidates are the gut seam's identity type re-applied to two other barrier surfaces, with a promotion path + falsifier each. This file is the single source the seam layer (repro/_seams/seam_wiring.py) and the live cross-package harness (repro/_harness/, section 17) read. It vendors faithfully; it imports NO sibling code. Each seam states OWNERSHIP and DIRECTION so neither volume re-derives the other's owned part (SSOT). Sibling owner DOIs are reconciled at cross-vendoring time; an unknown sibling DOI is a stated placeholder, NEVER a fabricated number.
_grade_legend: [V] measured in this volume's substrate dynamics; [F] forced / closed-form / architectural; [L] cited external anchor; [O] open (sibling-owned or external-anchor magnitude, obstacle stated).
_firewall_one_line: The immune EMERGENCE state (vp_imm_engine.circulate()) is computed with ZERO reference to a sibling quantity and carries no felt/affect/HPA/mind key, exactly as digestive's metabolic state is mind-free and mind is neuro-free. The only crossings are: a SHARED-SUBSTRATE identity (gut), a directional descriptor IN with magnitude left [O] (cortisol->suppressor), and one-way pointers OUT (cytokine->mood; escape->every cancer kernel; effector populations->circulatory transport; hematopoietic root->musculoskeletal marrow niche). The v0.18.0 respiratory/skin barrier-immunity entries are NAMED CANDIDATES, not declared seams: their immune-side endpoint (the T23/T24 tolerance saddle-node + suppressor complement, BARRIER-SURFACE-AGNOSTIC in closed form) is owned and verified HERE, while each surface's absolute antigen scale is owned by its (absent) barrier volume -- so they too consume NO sibling value. Every pointer/candidate consumes NO sibling value. Enforced by an architectural lock (zero sibling imports) + a hashed firewall check, not asserted.

_barrier_surface_agnostic._doc: v0.18.0 -- the structural footing for the respiratory/skin candidates below. The gut-immune seam proves induction = luminal antigen + spinodal(1.0) (T23 saddle-node) and maintenance = antigen - spinodal(1.0) (T24 suppressor complement) on the byte-identical mucosal R19 substrate (g = 1.0). This is BARRIER-SURFACE-AGNOSTIC: the relationship holds for ANY barrier-surface antigen, so the surface-independent OFFSET from that surface's own antigen baseline is ALWAYS +/- the spinodal(1.0). The gut (antigen 0.50) is the one vendored, live-verified point on a barrier-agnostic line; other barrier surfaces differ only in the antigen baseline they OWN. The saddle-node / suppressor-complement structure the offset rests on is the MEASURED T23/T24 result; the offset-invariance itself is closed-form [F]/architectural; each real surface's absolute antigen scale is [O], owned by that surface's volume.

So the niche HOUSES hematopoiesis but is not the same R19 switch -- the threshold-equality identity does not reduce.

identity_upgrade_RETIRED.falsifier_for_the_surviving_pointer: if the MSK substrate had NOT been byte-identical (drift != 0), even the one-way pointer would fail; the measured drift 0 is what keeps the housing pointer live-verified.
